purpose: Minimal record contract for planning_sources, geometry_audit, and later Hera payload intake.

field_notes.id: Stable slug, unique across local/global records.
field_notes.title: Dataset or catalog page title.
field_notes.status: acquired means local bytes are saved; candidate means usable lead not downloaded; blocked means known blocker.
field_notes.snapshot: Path relative to outputs/tayninh-data-batch-01 for the raw source snapshot.
field_notes.local_file: Path relative to outputs/tayninh-data-batch-01 for acquired data bytes, otherwise null.
field_notes.local_sha256: SHA-256 of local_file bytes for acquired records, otherwise null.
field_notes.license: License/access statement, or null when not stated.
field_notes.license_url: License URL, or null when not stated.
field_notes.data_date: Dataset temporal date or period, or null when unknown.
field_notes.captured_at: UTC ISO timestamp when snapshot/local bytes were captured.
field_notes.crs: Horizontal CRS, or null when unknown/not applicable.
field_notes.vertical_datum: Vertical datum for elevation products, or null when absent/unknown.
field_notes.resolution: Spatial resolution or scale, or null when unknown/not applicable.
field_notes.evidence_span: Verbatim text that appears inside snapshot.
field_notes.requirements: Array of review groups (R01-R23) and/or question IDs from outputs/review-gia-loc/question-inventory.csv.
field_notes.limitations: Array of explicit limits; use honest nulls instead of guesses.
